visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Pass Instead of Sorting
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array is sorted and then scanned backwards past duplicates. Find the second largest distinct value in one pass without changing the array. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Sorting costs n log n and rearranges the caller's data just to read one value. Two variables find the answer in a single pass and leave the array untouched.
